summary: LG CNS Co., Ltd. operates as an IT service company in South Korea and internationally. The company offers solutions on infrastructure, Artificial intelligence, robot transformation, Biz data, biz process intelligence, enterprise solutions, smart factory, smart logistics, smart city and space, and customer experience. It also provides consulting and industry specific services. The company was formerly known as LG-EDS Systems and changed its name to LG CNS Co., Ltd. in January 2002. LG CNS Co., Ltd. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
